item.title: Monaco to go zero waste for the fifth edition of MonaCollecte
item.description: Zero-waste cooking, homemade cosmetics, recycled plastic builds and a VR sorting centre — Monaco's two-day sustainability festival has something for every age group.

item.title: Monaco startup Sea Further wins prestigious European research grant
item.description: A Monaco-based startup has become the first company incubated at MonacoTech to be selected for funding under Horizon Europe, the European Union's principal research and innovation programme.

item.title: Interview Dr Raha Didevar: there’s a new psychologist in town, and she’s not just here to listen
item.description: Dr Raha Didevar has just opened her practice in the principality, bringing a solutions-focused approach to families navigating privilege, disconnection and the modern challenges of raising children.

item.title: The remarkable story behind the prehistoric museum Prince Albert II visited on Italian border
item.description: Just over the border from Monaco, the Balzi Rossi caves hold layers of human history stretching back 400,000 years. Prince Albert II visited the site this week, continuing a scientific legacy begun by Prince Albert I.

item.title: The French Riviera is hosting its first major longevity summit this month
item.description: A two-day summit bringing together some of the world's leading researchers and practitioners in longevity science, biohacking and preventive health will take place across Monaco and Nice on 11th and 12th March

item.title: Social media addiction is the theme of Monaco’s first digital lecture
item.description: How much time do you spend on your phone? If the answer makes you slightly uncomfortable, you're not alone — and Monaco wants to talk about it.

item.title: Prince Albert II urges arctic cooperation at Rome’s Arctic Circle Forum
item.description: Prince Albert II was one of the keynote speakers during the Arctic Circle Forum in Rome. During his address, he called for scientific cooperation and respect for international law to remain at the centre of Arctic policy

item.title: Monaco’s 500-year-old olive tree finds a permanent home in Osaka
item.description: A commemorative plaque marking one of Monaco's most unusual diplomatic gifts has been unveiled in Osaka, formalising the donation of a 500-year-old olive tree from Prince Albert II to the Japanese city.

item.title: Prince Albert II visits MonaCollecte meeting Monaco’s youngest recyclers
item.description: Prince Albert II officially opened this year's MonaCollecte event, witnessing young pupils from local schools learning more about zero waste initiatives.

item.title: Monaco’s Jardin Exotique to reopen at the end of March after years of renovation
item.description: Monaco residents are invited to see the renovated garden before it officially opens to the public on 30th March.
